software.scope: UI lifecycle notification collection only; no event-name-to-quiescence inference, no permission hook/journalwrite/replay. No package/build/install/cold158Native witness yet.

primary_API_findings: UnitPanel subscribes to UI Events.UnitOperationsCleared, UnitOperationAdded, UnitOperationDeactivated, UnitCommandStarted, UnitMoveComplete and UnitMovementPointsChanged. Cleared/deactivated handlers accept(player,unitId,hOperation,iData1) and request UI refresh for selected IDs.

WorldInput compares UnitCommandStarted hCommand to UnitCommandTypes.CANCEL and calls UnitMovementCancel. This establishes existing UI use, not that a settler can cancel or that every native queue is quiescent.
UnitPanel and UnitFlagManager read UnitManager.GetActivityType and ACTIVITY_SLEEP/HOLD/AWAKE. No WAKE command support or native operation/cancellation contract is inferred.
Owner_review: Factory binds only six known UI Events, prevalidates Add/Remove, filters exact numeric owner0/fullID8650807, retains<=64 matching rows with raw arity/typed nil-inclusive<=16 arguments/turn and separate other/malformed/drop/error counters. expected_unit_type is a configured identity, not a claimed native unit-type observation.

No unit query/order, property write, permission return, controller Update/RunNow, journal reconciliation or operation retry. Read deep copies and Retire uses exact saved callback references; foreign bindings and other handlers survive.

Review corrected repeated Retire after a foreign event replacement so an earlier incomplete result stays incomplete. Explicit false Add/Remove results count as errors while nil API returns remain permitted.

15 actual helper cases execute in both Lua5.1 and5.3: arity/nil, full ID and owner filtering, deep copy, capacity/drop, idempotence, foreign handler preservation, missing events, failing/throwing Add/Remove, foreign event objects, unknown scalar/clock and argument truncation.30VM executions are software evidence only.

Observer is not packaged, installed or exercised against old158 in Native. There is no new event, cancellation or recovery evidence. CoreCanStartOperation is qualification; a lifecycle notification name alone cannot clear/replay the old ARMED receipt or certify all queues.
